title: The dead-letter destination is full or unwritable
description: The dead-letter queue is at capacity or refuses writes while a poison message must be parked; consumption must stop and alarm instead of dropping the message or advancing the checkpoint.
callerVisible: Not caller visible; the operator sees the alarm and the held backlog.
backendEvidence: Consumer stopped with the source checkpoint kept
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:DLQ_FULL] owned by WP-07 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the dead-letter destination is at capacity or unwritable (ElasticMQ)

postconditions: No message is dropped and the source checkpoint is not advanced
Redelivery after recovery creates no duplicate effect
